todos: Sign the generated installer and rerun release verification with -RequireSigned -RunInstallLifecycle on a clean Windows profile or verification machine; include upgrade and rollback installers when a previous release candidate exists.

Manually verify integrated image generation on the target NVIDIA machine with DirectML GPU selected: model download, SHA256 or snapshot verification, runtime status showing DirectML before generation, prompt generation, saved gallery entry, generated file retrieval, and no fallbackReason unless DirectML actually fails.

Manually verify integrated image generation CPU fallback by disabling GPU preference or forcing a DirectML initialization failure, then confirm runtime status shows CPU with a clear fallbackReason and generation still saves retrievable images.

Run representative runtime workflows on the target deployment scope that are not fully covered by automated checks: real OCR on scanned PDF/image with NVIDIA runtime and CPU fallback, real Qdrant document import/search/chat indexing, Ollama chat/embedding/translation using chosen local models, and LibreOffice PDF translation export.

Monitor and add the next OCR NVIDIA CUDA runtime target beyond cuda130 when PaddlePaddle publishes stable Windows win_amd64 paddlepaddle-gpu wheels for newer CUDA SDK targets such as cu132 or cu133; update runtime-manifest.json, requirements-nvidia-cu*.txt, Test-OcrRuntimeCatalog.ps1, then verify the installed app provisions and uses the new GPU runtime successfully.
